items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Nunzio Scaglione. Scag he used to call him. ... Now this, I didn't know these people.

ctx.x: Monk, this is Monk Smith, Benji White, Earl Crum, Lois Farrell, Grené Jalpe, and now the violin players, Eblen Ra, I never did know him. Yeah. I didn't know him. Yeah, he'd be wrong. And then Dick Mackey. And this is Johnny Barsdorf's band at the Tokyo Gardens, 1922. Morton Abraham was Chick Morton. Mm-hmm. Tom Brown, trombone. Johnny Barsdorf, trumpet. Leo Addy, pothead. I used to call him pothead. Oh, yeah. But it had nothing to do with, with pot. Johnny Miller, he was, I could break a piano for you. Yeah.…

He was clarinet, first clarinet and alto player at the Low State Theatre. Now this, I didn't know these people. Oh, man, Pansy Lane, I didn't know him, Alfred Lane's other. I didn't know them. Believe me, I didn't know them. This, I didn't know Freddie Christian's band. I didn't know them. I didn't know them. This, this is, this is the band that was at the, this is the band that was at the Hollywood Club. Yeah. I don't know how this is taken inside. Pretty much, I'll get a little club. Well, this is, this is…
